frontmatter.name: bench-integrity
frontmatter.description: Checks that a race is fair and reproducible: same statement and parameters on both sides, builds match the pinned commits and patches in races.json, proofs verify, and the README numbers match what the dashboard measures.

frontmatter.name: design-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Visual design reviewer for the falcon-stwo-race dashboard. Judges only the rendered page (hierarchy, spacing, grid, type, motion, responsive fit, premium feel) from real screenshots, and returns a score out of 10 with concrete fixes per component.

frontmatter.name: senior-dev-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Senior reviewer for falcon-stwo-race. Reviews every non-trivial change for correctness, process safety (spawned provers, cleanup, timeouts), honesty of the measurements and code quality. Use it before calling a change done.
